name: huta press relay
description: Relays Telegram inline-button presses with callback_data huta:... to huta's local unix socket. No LLM involvement.

socketPath.description: huta's press socket (the gateway user needs write permission on it)

feedback.description: errors (default): reply only when huta refused or was unavailable (huta edits its own DM message on success); reply: always post huta's text; none: never
